costumes.text: HP:                                    XP:                                         MP:                                   LV.                                ST:                                    Gold:                                  *      *

[use arrows to cange help page]CONTROLS: -move and jump with W,A,D-cange wepon with S-press left mouse button to attack-press E to talk/go in buildings                                                            Page 01

[use arrows to cange help page]CONTROLS: -press Q to use item(Hp potion,...) -press 1 and 2 to cange selected item -press SPACE  to run[press right arrow for more]                                                                Page 02

[use arrows to cange help page]ITEMS:*HP potion (gives 5 HP)*MP potion (gives 5 MP)*ST potion (gives 5 ST)*Slime (thrown it with Q when        selected)                                                                  Page 03

[use arrows to cange help page]ITEMS: *Berrys (gives 1 HP)    *Meat ( no effect,you can sell it)  *TIP: sell slime balls!      [press right arrow for more]                                                               Page 04

[use arrows to cange help page]SOME ENEMYS: *Green Blob: -weak and stupid                        -levels: 1-3                    -Gives: 0-2 slime balls                                                                    Page 05

[use arrows to cange help page]ENEMYS: *Forest Blob: -strong,can shoot                         -levels: 3-4                   -Gives: 0-1 slime balls                           or 0-1 meat slices                                                               Page 06

[use arrows to cange help page]MORE INFO -hold L to see your save/load code and  your Quest code.-Quest code loads your completed quests and your unlocked map locations                                                                     Page 07

[use arrows to cange help page]MORE INFO-save/load code ("code") loads your level,             xp,coins,your items,your Hp,Mp,St...and its very big LOL                                                          Page 08

[use arrows to cange help page]MORE INFO -click on map,then click on RED dots  to TELEPORT...-when you level up,click on UPGRADE  to upgrade your HP,MP or ST.                                                     Page 09

[use arrows to cange help page]MORE INFO -Go to options and click on the player  to cange it :D-you can cane the music and disable tutorial in the options!                                                     Page 10
Hello young warrior,dont go close to Blobs territory,they will attack you.                          press E
Btw,could you bring me 4 slime balls? I will give you 10 coins.          press E to accept
You did you found the slime balls? They areeasy to get from blobs.                         press E
Thank you!!! Here you go your coins...                                         press E
Oh,hi.Its a nice day isnt it?                                                 press E
Hello,Its a realy nice day for a walk.                     press E
Once upon a time,there were 7 "Titans",the magical and powerful half-god creatures... [PRESS SPACE]
They wanted to rule the world themselves,so they started a war with a  human race... but  humans were too weak... [PRESS SPACE]
So the 4 great Wizards gave their souls to captor the Titans in 7 towers around the world... [PRESS SPACE]
The world lived in peace for many years... [PRESS SPACE]
But now one of them has escaped and you need to find him and defeat before he free the others!!! [PRESS SPACE]
**********LOVE the PROJECT and go save the world!!!!***********
What are you doing here joung warrior?These woods are realydangerous...                      press E
Btw,I dont have anymeat left,so could youbring me 2 pices?             press E
Im getting hungry....Where is that meat?          press E
Thank you! Here you go8 coins!         press E
Its a good day for  hunting,isnt it?           press E
Hello again my littlefrined!                   press E
Peapol are talkingthat 1 of the Titansescaped,but i thinkthats impossible...                    press E
Over there is a swamp.Its very dangerous,sodont go there if you arentready...               [PRESS E]
Do you want me to  teleport you to the moutain zone?          [Y for YES] [x for NO]
Do you want me to  return you back to the village?          [Y for YES] [x for NO]
Hi you there! Could you bring me 4 berrys? Im making a potion so I need them...                   press E
Did you found those berrys? Hurry up...                  press E
Thanks pal! Here you go12 coins!!                   press E
Hi pal,would you like to buy a ring for 0.5 extra dagme? It will cost you 30 coins.    Y for yes  |  X for no
Sorry you dont have  30 coins,come backwhen you collect some!          PRESS E
Thanks for buying it! see you around :)             PRESS E
Hi pal nice to see you!                     PRESS E
Would you like to buy a ring for 30 coins? it will give you 0.5 Pow.    Y for yes  |  X for no
Nice to see you kid.           PRESS E
*Ssssshhh* i took a pony from a little girl,dont tell anyone...           PRESS E
Would you like to buy some armor for 50 coins? It will give you +6 HP!   Y for yes  |  X for no
Nice sword you got    there...                    [PRESS Z]
You need a Red Gem if you wish to pass this doors and enter the magical Kingdom.               [PRESS E]
Would you like to buy winged boots for 30? They will give you  +6 Stamina!!!    Y for yes  |  X for no
Are you happy with your new boots? :D                   [PRESS E]
I ate a glowing apple...                   [PRESS E]

Welcome to shop!!! Press SPACE to exit ~ click "buy" to buy items ~ click "sell" to sell----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                HP potion                  Berrys                cost:10                      cost:2                [5+ HP]                      [+1 HP]                MP potion                 Meat                cost:8                        cost:4                [+5 MP]                     [no effect]                               ST potion                  Slime ball                cost:8                       cost:2                [+5 ST]                      [Does 1 dmg.]
*Press SPACE to exit*       = Enemy Area      = Unlocked Area       = Portal Area        = Locked Area

Use S to cange your wepon and left mouse button to attack.
Press 1 or 2 to cange the selected item...

Press E to go in buildings/talk to people...

TIP: You can use RED dotson the MAP to teleport... ( Z )
TIP: Sell items you found tothe shop to get extra coins ( Z )
TIP: You can disable this tutorial in main menu options...(press Z)
